description.value: Sharetea is a Taiwanese bubble tea franchise founded in 1992, serving premium boba tea made with high-quality tea leaves imported directly from Taiwan. With over 400 stores worldwide, this Vancouver location offers a wide variety of milk teas, fruit teas, ice-blended drinks, and customizable toppings such as tapioca pearls, pudding, and lychee jelly. A convenient refreshment stop for cyclists passing through the area.
